param_types.unit_key: 单位稳定键；internal 为 true 时须为内部单位（internal_only），为 false 时须为可选单位
param_types.rational: [分子, 分母] 正整数倍率
param_types.int_list: 整数列表；length 为固定长度，或以 min_length/max_length 给出长度范围；min/max 作用于每个元素
param_types.rational_list: [分子, 分母] 列表；min_length/max_length 为长度范围，min/max 作用于每个元素
param_types.sound_key: 音效稳定键（content.json 或模组 content.sounds 中登记，可见范围与单位动作脚本 op23 相同）
param_types.sound_list: 音效稳定键列表；min_length/max_length 为长度范围

doc.ZS: 工兵类单位：出击后修筑指定的内部单位（如召唤箱）。修筑时间按倍率调整（状态词 38，向上取整）；兵种浏览、出兵格与属性面板显示修筑完成后的单位。
doc.EN: Builder units construct the given internal unit after deployment. The construction time (status word 38, rounded up) is scaled by the multiplier. The unit viewer, deck card and status panel show the finished structure.

doc.ZS: 召唤箱类单位：按计量周期召唤指定的可选单位。首次计量（状态词 38）与后续间隔（状态词 39，含计量零值的一帧）先按 interval_multiplier、再按 interval_additional_multiplier 调整。
doc.EN: Summoning structures periodically summon the given selectable unit. The first gauge (status word 38) and later intervals (status word 39, including the zero-gauge frame) are scaled by interval_multiplier, then by interval_additional_multiplier.

doc.ZS: 投放与架设类单位：出击时由原生流程生成指定的内部单位（伞兵运输、迫击炮架设）。属性面板显示内部单位的数值。
doc.EN: Deployer units (paratrooper drop, mortar emplacement) spawn the given internal unit through the native flow. The status panel shows the internal unit's values.

doc.ZS: 空降中的内部单位：落地后转换为指定的可选单位（替代原生固定的 UnitID 45）。
doc.EN: Falling paratrooper (internal unit) turns into the given selectable unit on landing, replacing the native fixed UnitID 45.

doc.ZS: 地面木乃伊类单位改用垂吊木乃伊（UnitID 157）的发射动作：攻击时释放虫群。虫群脚本、伤害与距离由单位的精灵描述符与攻击参数决定。
doc.EN: Ground mummy units use the hanging mummy's (UnitID 157) shot action and release an insect swarm. Swarm scripts, damage and range come from the unit's sprite descriptor and attack parameters.

doc.ZS: 受击后的恢复动作改用精灵描述符中的指定动画槽（原生固定为槽 26）；用于自定义描述符把槽 26 另作他用的情形。
doc.EN: The recovery animation after being knocked back uses the given sprite-descriptor slot instead of the native slot 26, for descriptors that use slot 26 for something else.

doc.ZS: 坦克类单位的绝招喷火：喷火阶段受击时，按已喷出的时长改用收尾受击动画（alternate_knockback_animation 起 5 个槽），并由收尾弹体动画完成最后一次判定（ending_bullet_animations 依次对应起始段三组与标准收尾）。
doc.EN: Tank-class special flame attack. When knocked back during the flame, the unit switches to an ending knockback animation chosen by elapsed flame time (5 slots starting at alternate_knockback_animation), and an ending bullet animation performs the final hit (ending_bullet_animations: three early-phase groups and the standard ending).

doc.ZS: 同一次绝招的喷火对同一目标最多击退一次。
doc.EN: One special attack's flame knocks back the same target at most once.

doc.ZS: 坦克类单位的绝招状态（50）每帧沿用原生冲刺单位的地形移动流程，坡地上冲刺不悬空。
doc.EN: During the special attack state (50), tank-class units use the native dash units' terrain movement every frame, so dashes follow slopes.

doc.ZS: 马可、塔玛、英里、菲欧及其胖形态、圣诞英里、圣诞菲欧类单位：首次绝招后保留强化武器，之后的远程普通攻击使用原生绝招参数组（伤害、命中与射程），并保持持枪动作；胖英里保留大激光。与原版十类角色的行为相同。
doc.EN: Marco, Tarma, Eri, Fio, their fat forms, Christmas Eri and Christmas Fio class units keep the special weapon after the first special attack: later ranged normal attacks use the native special-attack parameter group (damage, hit and range) and keep the armed pose; Fat Eri keeps the large laser. Same behaviour as the ten stock characters.

doc.ZS: 按生命分档换外观（僵尸类单位，基准为僵尸（青年））。thresholds 为各档的生命比例（由高到低，生命低于最大生命×该比例即进入该档）；第 k 档使用精灵描述符的槽 原生槽号+16k（槽 0–2、6、7、9–12），同一动作换档时保留播放位置。transitions 中为 1 的档位先经状态 80 播放该档的槽 12（过渡动作，可在脚本中生成掉落效果与音效）。rage_stage 档起移速与普攻、绝招伤害按倍率改变（狂暴）。雪地步兵类单位（基准 182，推雪球的小兵 W.SOLDIER）同样可用：只就地换档，transitions 须全为 0，不支持狂暴（该动作类不处理状态 80，出击即不被击退）。
doc.EN: Zombie-class units (base: Zombie (Young Man)) change appearance by remaining HP. thresholds are HP fractions in descending order (HP below max HP times the fraction enters that stage). Stage k uses sprite-descriptor slot native slot + 16k (slots 0-2, 6, 7, 9-12); switching stages keeps the playback position of the same action. Stages marked 1 in transitions first play that stage's slot 12 through state 80 (a transition that can spawn drop effects and sounds from its script). From rage_stage on, move speed and normal/special damage change by the multipliers. Also available for snowball-soldier class units (base 182, W.SOLDIER): stages only switch in place, transitions must all be 0 and rage is not supported (that action class does not process state 80 and is never knocked back).

doc.ZS: 受击时不进入击退（不检查击退计量），生命归零时照常倒下。基准 200（飞行侵略者类，BattleAction_WingedInvader）同样适用（行为库 v14）。
doc.EN: The unit is never knocked back by hits (the knockback gauge is not checked); it still dies when HP reaches zero. Also applies to base 200 (Winged Invader class, BattleAction_WingedInvader; library v14).

doc.ZS: 原生每帧按横坐标为两队各取最前单位，攻击距离、阻挡与移动限制只看对方最前单位；单位落到对方最前单位之后时距离为负，原生一直攻击而攻击框内没有敌人，与其重叠的对方单位也不能越过它移动。本单位（或以本单位为对方最前单位的对方单位）的对方最前单位中心位于其中心之后时，改以其前方最近的对方单位计算攻击距离、阻挡与移动限制；资格与次序同原生。前方没有对方单位时按原生的无对方单位处理。
doc.EN: Natively each team's front unit is chosen by x position every frame, and attack distance, blocking and the movement limit only look at the opposing front unit; a unit that ends up behind that front unit gets a negative distance and keeps attacking an empty attack box, and opposing units overlapping it cannot move past it. When the opposing front unit's centre is behind this unit's centre (or behind an opposing unit whose front unit is this unit), attack distance, blocking and the movement limit use the nearest opposing unit in front instead, chosen with the native eligibility and ordering. With no opposing unit in front, the native no-enemy handling applies.

doc.ZS: 生命分档单位被击退时播放当前档的槽 14（槽 14+16k），不经槽 12 重播该档的过渡动作。原生在进入状态 80 时请求槽 12：生命已越过下一个带过渡的档位时仍播放过渡（槽 12+16k），否则为击退，改用槽 14+16k（原生 ZombieBrain 不使用槽 14）。滑行距离与时长由该脚本的 op7 与帧决定。不能与 no_knockback 同时使用。
doc.EN: When a staged-HP unit is knocked back it plays the current stage's slot 14 (slot 14+16k) instead of replaying that stage's transition from slot 12. The native code requests slot 12 when entering state 80: if HP has crossed the next stage with a transition, the transition (slot 12+16k) still plays; otherwise it is a knockback and slot 14+16k is used (native ZombieBrain never uses slot 14). The slide distance and duration come from that script's op7 commands and frames. Cannot be combined with no_knockback.

doc.ZS: 生命处于 until_stage 档之前（防具仍在）时，每次受击播放音效（两个音效时交替）。until_stage 为档数 + 1 时在所有档位都播放。
doc.EN: While HP is above stage until_stage (the armor is still on), each hit plays the sound (two sounds alternate). With until_stage equal to the number of stages + 1 the sound plays in every stage.

doc.ZS: 本单位的攻击使目标生命归零时播放音效。
doc.EN: Plays the sound when this unit's attack brings a target's HP to zero.

doc.ZS: 进入 stage 档时（该档须有过渡动作），在过渡动作的第 release_tick 帧投出指定的内部单位（以本单位等级生成，每个单位只投一次）。内部单位应为被投出的飞行单位（基准 160，thrown_flight 与 para_drop_transform）。
doc.EN: When the unit enters stage (which must have a transition), it throws the given internal unit at frame release_tick of the transition (spawned at this unit's level, once per unit). The internal unit should be a thrown flying unit (base 160 with thrown_flight and para_drop_transform).

doc.ZS: 被投出的飞行单位：从投出者位置前方 forward、高 height 处出发（世界坐标），不使用空降的固定起始高度；飞行轨迹由精灵描述符槽 8 的脚本（op7）决定，落地后转为 para_drop_transform 指定的单位。base_clearance 大于 0 时，飞行中前缘与敌方据点前缘的间距不小于该值（世界坐标）：将越过时停在该处并垂直落下，避免越过或嵌入敌方据点（2026-10-15 起被投出的小鬼为 16）。
doc.EN: Thrown flying unit: starts forward and height (world units) from the thrower instead of the fixed paratrooper drop height; the flight path comes from the slot 8 script (op7) of its sprite descriptor, and it turns into the para_drop_transform unit on landing. With base_clearance above 0 the flying unit keeps at least that gap (world units) between its front edge and the enemy base front edge: when it would pass that point it stops there and drops straight down, so it never lands inside or behind the enemy base (16 for the thrown imp since 2026-10-15).

doc.ZS: 雪地步兵类单位以爆炸属性（属性 2）被击毁时，原生 ZakoSnow 在状态 110 生成血色效果 0xff01，状态 110 与状态 100 只差这一项（两者都播放槽 13 并转入状态 140）。带此行为的单位按状态 100 处理，只播放本单位的死亡动作；火焰属性（状态 120）不变。
doc.EN: When a snow-soldier-class unit is destroyed by an explosive attack (attribute 2), the native ZakoSnow code adds the red splash effect 0xff01 in state 110; that is the only difference from state 100 (both play slot 13 and move to state 140). Units with this behaviour are handled as state 100 and only play their own death animation; fire deaths (state 120) are unchanged.

doc.ZS: 自爆：进入攻击（状态 30/40）与特殊攻击（状态 50）时按原版 HOPPER MECHA（UnitID 39）的流程处理：普通攻击播放槽 8、特殊攻击播放槽 9，动作开始即不被选为目标、不阻挡、不能再发动绝招，动作播完后单位消失（不经死亡流程，对方不获得击毁奖励）；动作中不会被击退或打断。伤害取动作开始时的攻击组（普通攻击为词 22、特殊攻击为词 29），攻击框与音效写在这两个槽的脚本中。unmirrored_from_tick ≥ 0 时，攻击动作开始后第该 tick 起按素材原朝向绘制（不随队伍翻转，单位朝向与判定不变；用于带文字的爆炸图）。
doc.EN: Self-destruct: attacks (states 30/40) and the special (state 50) follow the native HOPPER MECHA (UnitID 39) flow: the normal attack plays slot 8 and the special plays slot 9; from the start the unit is no longer targeted, does not block and cannot use its special, and it disappears when the animation ends (no death flow, no kill reward for the enemy). It cannot be knocked back or interrupted meanwhile. Damage uses the attack group active when the animation starts (word 22 for the normal attack, word 29 for the special); attack boxes and sounds go in the two slot scripts. With unmirrored_from_tick ≥ 0, from that tick of the attack animation the sprite is drawn in its original art direction (not flipped by team; the unit direction and hit boxes are unchanged), for explosion art that contains text.

doc.ZS: 本单位的攻击不命中空中单位（身体状态 NoTarget）与战场道具（UnitID 116、231、289、363），只打地面单位与据点。
doc.EN: This unit's attacks never hit air units (body state NoTarget) or stage items (UnitID 116, 231, 289, 363); they hit ground units and the base only.

doc.ZS: 行进射击：待机与行进（状态 10、20）的动作脚本中的 op22[弹体槽, 命中槽, x, y]（x、y 为素材坐标，同原生）在最近的敌方单位前缘距离不超过 range 时发射弹体，否则不发射；射击节奏由脚本中 op22 的位置决定。弹体的伤害、击退值、目标数、弹速与行程取近距参数组（词 15–21，可用 status_word_values 写入六个等级锚点），接触敌人后的啃咬照常使用普通攻击组。
doc.EN: Shooting while walking: op22[bullet slot, hit slot, x, y] (art coordinates, as in native scripts) in the idle and walk scripts (states 10 and 20) fires a bullet when the nearest enemy front edge is within range, and does nothing otherwise; the firing rhythm comes from where op22 sits in the scripts. Bullet damage, knockback value, target count, speed and travel come from the short-range group (words 15–21, settable per level anchor with status_word_values); biting on contact uses the normal attack group as usual.

doc.ZS: 气球飞行：生命分档的第 0 档为飞行段（第 1 档须有过渡动作，即放手与落地）。飞行中不被选为目标、不阻挡、不被阻挡、不被击退，也不攻击任何敌人；高度由动作脚本的受击框（op3）与帧位置表达。前缘与敌方据点前缘的间距不超过 pop_distance、生命降到第 1 档或发动绝招时放手（主动放手时生命截到第 1 档以下），播放第 1 档的过渡动作后按地面单位行动，此后不再有绝招。launch_sound 为出场时的音效（可省略）。
doc.EN: Balloon flight: HP stage 0 is the flying phase (stage 1 needs a transition: letting go and landing). While flying the unit is not targeted, does not block, is not blocked, is not knocked back and attacks nothing; its height comes from the hit boxes (op3) and frame positions in the scripts. It lets go when its front edge is within pop_distance of the enemy base front edge, when HP drops to stage 1, or when the special is used (letting go early cuts HP below stage 1); after the stage 1 transition it acts as a ground unit and has no special any more. launch_sound plays when it enters the field (optional).

doc.ZS: 炸药（原住民（鸟）类）：投出的弹体碰到敌人时立即播放 blast_animation（爆炸），落在地面时播放 fuse_animation（引信燃烧后爆炸），动画播完后消失（同原生迫击炮弹）；原生弹体碰到敌人或落地后直接消失、不爆炸。爆炸的攻击框、目标数（状态词 24/31）与音效写在这两个槽的脚本中，伤害与攻击属性取投出时的攻击组（普通攻击词 22/28，特殊攻击词 29/37）。special_spread_count 大于 0 时，动作脚本中 op22 的弹体槽在 special_spread_first 起连续 special_spread_count 个槽内的弹体（通常在特殊攻击中同时投出）以该槽为弹体动画，第 i 颗（1 起）落在 状态词 33（绝招弹体目的距离）× i / special_spread_count 处，即在射程内等距分布，射程随等级或倍率改变时落点随之改变；其余 op22 照旧，落在原生的普通攻击目的距离处（弹体动画为槽 26）。
doc.EN: Dynamite (NATIVE(BIRD) class): a thrown projectile that touches an enemy plays blast_animation (explodes at once); one that lands on the ground plays fuse_animation (the fuse burns, then it explodes); it disappears when the animation ends, as the native mortar shell does. Native projectiles of this class disappear on contact or landing without exploding. Put the blast attack box, target count (words 24/31) and sounds in these two slots; damage and attack attribute come from the attack group active at the throw (normal: words 22/28, special: words 29/37). With special_spread_count > 0, op22 calls whose bullet slot lies in the special_spread_count slots starting at special_spread_first (usually thrown together in the special attack) use that slot as the projectile animation, and the i-th one (from 1) lands at word 33 (special projectile target distance) × i / special_spread_count: evenly spread up to the range, following any change of the range by level or multipliers. Other op22 calls keep the native path and land at the native normal-attack target distance (projectile slot 26).

doc.ZS: 按攻击属性区分死亡动作（原住民（鸟）类）：原生的死亡状态 100（普通）、110（爆炸属性击杀）、120（火焰属性击杀）都播放槽 12；带此行为时 110 改为 explosion_animation、120 改为 fire_animation，100 仍为槽 12（同叛军步兵等小兵的三种死亡）。动作播完后单位消失。三个 *_variant_animation 非 0 时为对应死亡的另一版本（通常只换死亡语音）：死亡时单位横坐标取整为奇数则播放该版本，偶数则播放前者；只由当时的位置决定，回放与联机时双方结果相同。
doc.EN: Death animation by attack attribute (NATIVE(BIRD) class): the native death states 100 (normal), 110 (killed by an explosive attack) and 120 (killed by fire) all play slot 12. With this behaviour state 110 plays explosion_animation and 120 plays fire_animation, while 100 keeps slot 12, like the three deaths of rebel infantry. The unit disappears when the animation ends. A non-zero *_variant_animation is another version of that death (usually only the death voice differs): it plays when the unit's x coordinate, truncated to an integer, is odd at death, and the base version plays when it is even. The choice depends only on the position at that moment, so replays and both sides of an online match agree.

doc.ZS: 效果贴地：本单位以动作脚本 op12 生成的独立效果中，动作号为 animation 的效果在绘制时，各分件按其中心所在横坐标的战场地形高度上下平移（保持分件相对效果原点的纵向偏移），横向排开的火焰等效果因此沿坡道铺在地表上，不穿入地形，也不悬空。只改变绘制位置，效果对象的坐标、攻击框以及回放与联机的状态不变；动作浏览中按原样绘制。
doc.EN: Ground-hugging effect: among the independent effects this unit creates with op12 in its scripts, the effect playing animation is drawn with each sprite part shifted vertically to the battlefield terrain height at the part's centre x (keeping the part's vertical offset from the effect origin), so a row of flames or similar effects lies on the ground along slopes instead of cutting into the terrain or floating above it. Only drawing changes: the effect object's position, attack boxes and replay/online state are unchanged. The unit viewer draws the effect unchanged.

doc.ZS: 钢铁哨兵第一形态：单位以原生保留的 BattleAction_IronSlider 运行（MSD 1.46 未发布的 IRON SLIDER，UnitID 394），脚本采用 MSA 7.13.0 IRON SENTINEL 的动作记录编号（待机 6、行走 7、普通攻击 9、绝招 10、攻击后等待 11、受击后退 12、损毁 13；菜单 0–2）。核心按 MSA 处理：普通攻击的火箭（脚本编号 60）升出舞台上沿后从上沿外瞄准对方最前方单位落下，目标不在攻击距离边缘以内时落向边缘的地面，水平飞离发射点达远程投射距离（字 26）即爆炸；绝招的主炮导弹（64）、侧炮炮弹（50、56、105、111、117、124、130、136）与残片（72、73）按 MSA 编号建立；损毁动画播完后召唤 second_form 指定的内部单位（第二形态）。
doc.EN: Iron Sentinel first form: the unit runs on the native BattleAction_IronSlider kept in MSD 1.46 (the unreleased IRON SLIDER, UnitID 394), with scripts numbered as in the MSA 7.13.0 IRON SENTINEL action record (standby 6, walk 7, normal attack 9, special 10, post-attack wait 11, knockback slide 12, destruction 13; menu 0-2). The core follows MSA: normal-attack rockets (script id 60) rise off the top of the stage and come down from above onto the opposing front-most unit, aiming at the ground at the edge of the attack range when that unit is beyond it, and explode once they are the far projectile distance (word 26) away from the launch point; the special's cannon missiles (64), side-cannon shells (50, 56, 105, 111, 117, 124, 130, 136) and debris (72, 73) are created by their MSA ids; after the destruction animation the internal unit given by second_form is summoned (second form).

doc.ZS: 钢铁哨兵第二形态：单位以原生保留的 BattleAction_IronSlider_2 运行（UnitID 395），出场时设为免击退（原生与 MSA 相同）；脚本编号同 MSA（待机 17、行走 18、巨型导弹 19、损毁 21），三种攻击都发射巨型导弹（脚本编号 24）。只用于由 iron_slider 召唤的内部单位。
doc.EN: Iron Sentinel second form: the unit runs on the native BattleAction_IronSlider_2 (UnitID 395) and is immune to knockback from its first update (as in both the native class and MSA); scripts use the MSA numbering (standby 17, walk 18, giant missile 19, destruction 21) and all three attacks launch the giant missile (script id 24). Only for the internal unit summoned by iron_slider.

doc.ZS: 沙包类建筑（基准 4，BattleAction_Donou）：损毁动画（状态 100 / 110 / 120 播放的槽 8）播完、原生移除单位之前，在单位原点放共用爆炸效果 0xff04（同 MSA 能量核心）。损毁动画本身与移除时刻不变。
doc.EN: Sandbag-class structures (base 4, BattleAction_Donou): when the destruction animation (slot 8, states 100/110/120) has finished, the shared explosion effect 0xff04 is placed at the unit origin just before the native code removes the unit (as with the MSA energy core). The destruction animation and the removal timing are unchanged.

doc.ZS: 飞行护盾（MSA 7.13.0 FLYING SHELT 的 BattleAction_FlyingShell 按 MSD 原生飞行侵略者类实现）：飞行高度为地形之上 height；普攻与绝招的弹体由原生 WingedInvader::shotBullet 发射（op22 的第 2 个值须为 0）。普攻的陨石为 arc_first_animation 起 arc_count 个弹体槽：按脚本的弧线飞出，动画播完后换为 homing_animation 并每 tick 向最近的敌方单位转向（每 tick 最多 turn_rate，4096 为一周），速度为弹体速度，水平飞离发射点超过投射距离（字 26）后爆炸。绝招开始时按前方最近的敌方单位（远攻击距离内，字 7）定一个落点，倒数 rain_delay tick；绝招的陨石为 rain_first_animation 起 rain_count 个弹体槽：按脚本升空，倒数结束时换为 homing_animation，从落点后上方 45° 斜落到落点附近。陨石有受击框时可挡下敌方攻击，生命为本单位最大生命的 meteor_hp_percent%（绝招陨石只在下落中受伤），生命耗尽、命中敌人、落地（换为 homing_animation 之后）或存在超过 meteor_lifetime tick 时以共用爆炸 0xff04 消失。损毁时在本单位三处放共用爆炸 0xff04，之后每 tick 在 随机位置放小爆炸 0xff03，直至移除。
doc.EN: Flying shell (MSA 7.13.0 FLYING SHELT, BattleAction_FlyingShell, implemented on the native Winged Invader class): the unit flies height above the terrain; normal and special bullets are fired by the native WingedInvader::shotBullet (the second op22 value must be 0). Normal-attack meteors are the arc_count bullet scripts from arc_first_animation: they fly the scripted arc, then switch to homing_animation and turn toward the nearest enemy unit each tick (at most turn_rate per tick, 4096 per full turn) at the bullet speed, exploding once they are farther from the launch point than the projectile distance (word 26). When the special starts, a landing point is taken at the nearest enemy unit ahead within the far attack range (word 7) and a rain_delay-tick countdown starts; special meteors are the rain_count bullet scripts from rain_first_animation: they rise as scripted and, when the countdown ends, switch to homing_animation and fall at 45 degrees from above and behind onto the landing area. Meteors with a hit box block enemy attacks; their HP is meteor_hp_percent% of the unit's maximum HP (special meteors take damage only while falling). A meteor disappears with the shared explosion 0xff04 when its HP runs out, when it hits an enemy, when it touches the ground after switching to homing_animation, or after meteor_lifetime ticks. On destruction the unit places three shared explosions 0xff04 and then one small explosion 0xff03 at a random point every tick until it is removed.

doc.ZS: 蜈蚣长老（MSA 7.13.0 ELDER CENTIPEDE 的 BattleAction_Eldercentipedo，按 MSD 原生侵略者类实现）：出击后由地下出土（appear_animation），待机为 neutral_animation；移动时钻地（burrow_animation）后在地下移动（underground_animation，高度取地形，无受击框）；远距离攻击时由地下出土（emerge_animation）、喷酸（long_attack_animation，飞沫为 droplet_first_animation 起 droplet_count 个弹体，以普攻组结算，命中或落地时放 splash_animation）、收尾（long_attack_end_animation）；绝招入地（dive_animation）后大前行（march_animation）：身体为该动作脚本前 wheel_parts 条 op11 子层组成的圆环，绕单位前方 280 处转一周，各节越过地面处生成地面攻击弹体（ground_hit_animation），头部在地面以上且未转过半周时单位的攻击框跟随头部，脚本中的 march_dirt_animation 泥土在圆环上生成并同时发射飞向圆环中心的酸块（march_blob_animation，命中动作 march_blob_hit_animation，绝招组结算），转满一周后出土。出土与钻地脚本中的 ground_hit_animation / ground_hit_alt_animation 弹体为贴地的地面攻击（绝招组结算，范围内多个目标）。受击为 flinch_animation、flinch_loop_animation，击退为 knockback_animation，损毁为 death_animation（在地下时先出土）；地面以上每 10 tick 在脚下放 smoke_first_animation 起三个动作轮换的尘土；绘制按地面高度裁切（地面以下的部分不画）。动作切换在客体流程中执行，脚本第一 tick 的音效照常播放。
doc.EN: Elder Centipede (MSA 7.13.0 ELDER CENTIPEDE, BattleAction_Eldercentipedo, implemented on the native Invader class): after deployment the unit rises from the ground (appear_animation) and idles with neutral_animation; to move it burrows (burrow_animation) and travels underground (underground_animation, height taken from the terrain, no hit box); for the far attack it rises (emerge_animation), sprays acid (long_attack_animation; the droplets are the droplet_count bullet scripts from droplet_first_animation, settled with the normal attack group, leaving splash_animation when they hit or land) and recovers (long_attack_end_animation); the special dives (dive_animation) and then marches (march_animation): the body is a ring made of the first wheel_parts op11 sub-layers of that script, turning once around a point 280 ahead of the unit; where a segment crosses the ground a ground-hit bullet (ground_hit_animation) is created, the unit attack box follows the head while it is above the ground during the first half turn, every march_dirt_animation dirt burst in the script is placed on the ring together with an acid blob (march_blob_animation, hit animation march_blob_hit_animation, special group) flying toward the ring centre, and the unit rises again after the full turn. Bullets ground_hit_animation / ground_hit_alt_animation fired by the rise and burrow scripts are ground hits at terrain height (special group, several targets). flinch_animation / flinch_loop_animation are the flinch, knockback_animation the knockback and death_animation the death (rising first when underground); above the ground a dust cloud from three animations starting at smoke_first_animation is placed under the unit every 10 ticks; the unit is drawn clipped at the ground line. Animation changes run in the guest flow, so sounds on the first tick of a script play normally.

doc.ZS: 沙包类建筑（基准 4，BattleAction_Donou）：受击动作（状态 60 播放的槽 7）中开启的攻击框按普通攻击组结算（伤害字 22、击退计量字 23、目标数字 24、属性字 28），槽 7 脚本中每次开启攻击框（op4）都重建攻击 ID，框内各目标每次开启各受 1 次伤害（一个周期开启 n 次即至多 n 次伤害）。原生沙包的攻击组为 0，受击动作不造成伤害。受击动作中再次受击不重新开始动作，持续受击时动作逐个周期连续播放。
doc.EN: Sandbag-class structures (base 4, BattleAction_Donou): attack boxes opened during the hit reaction (slot 7, played in state 60) are settled with the normal attack group (damage word 22, knockback gauge word 23, target count word 24, attribute word 28); every attack box opening (op4) in the slot 7 script starts a new attack id, so each target inside the box takes damage once per opening (n openings per cycle give at most n hits). The native sandbag has attack group 0 and its hit reaction deals no damage. Hits received during the reaction do not restart it; under continuous attack the reaction plays cycle after cycle.

doc.ZS: 侵略者之王（MSA 7.13.0 INVADER KING 的 BattleAction_InvaderKing，按 MSD 原生侵略者类实现）：不步行。出击后移到敌方最前方单位前缘之后（近攻击距离 − 2）处，关卡预置时在原处，自高处落下（fall_animation），到地面时着地踏击（land_animation，按远距攻击组结算）；待机为 neutral_animation；近距攻击为 near_attack_animation；远距攻击为跃起（jump_animation）离开画面，移到同样的出场位置后落下并着地踏击；绝招为 special_start_animation → special_animation → special_end_animation，其中的天空激光（sky_laser_first_animation 起 sky_laser_count 个弹体脚本，身体段 sky_laser_body_animation）与地面激光（ground_laser_first_animation 起 ground_laser_count 个，落点效果 ground_impact_animation 之后的第二条按落点地面高度建立）以绝招组结算，判定为沿激光方向、半宽 16 的长条；击退为 knockback_animation（后滑，其中的反击激光 counter_laser_animation 射向前方最近的敌方单位所在处的地面，身体段 counter_laser_body_animation，落点放 counter_burst_animation）；受击为 flinch_animation、flinch_loop_animation；损毁为 death_animation，其中的攻击框按远距攻击组、伤害为远距攻击的 2/3、属性爆炸结算。落下、着地、跃起与绝招期间不击退。单位菜单的动作演示使用 menu_neutral_animation、near_attack_animation、menu_long_animation、menu_special_animation。动作切换在客体流程中执行。
doc.EN: Invader King (MSA 7.13.0 INVADER KING, BattleAction_InvaderKing, implemented on the native Invader class): the unit does not walk. After deployment it moves behind the front edge of the foremost enemy unit by the near attack range minus 2 (a stage-placed unit stays where it is), drops from above (fall_animation) and stomps on landing (land_animation, settled with the normal attack group); it idles with neutral_animation; the near attack is near_attack_animation; the far attack leaps off screen (jump_animation), moves to the same appearance position, drops and stomps; the special is special_start_animation -> special_animation -> special_end_animation, whose sky lasers (sky_laser_count bullet scripts from sky_laser_first_animation, body segment sky_laser_body_animation) and ground lasers (ground_laser_count scripts from ground_laser_first_animation; the second one after each ground_impact_animation is created at that point's ground height) are settled with the special group and hit along a strip of half width 16 in the beam direction; the knockback is knockback_animation (sliding back; its counter laser counter_laser_animation, body counter_laser_body_animation, aims at the ground under the nearest enemy ahead and leaves counter_burst_animation there); flinch_animation / flinch_loop_animation are the flinch; death_animation is the destruction, whose attack box is settled with the normal group at 2/3 of the normal attack damage as an explosion. The unit is not knocked back while dropping, landing, leaping or using the special. The unit menu action demo uses menu_neutral_animation, near_attack_animation, menu_long_animation and menu_special_animation. Animation changes run in the guest flow.
